title: A Peaceful 4-Day Autumn Journey
summary: A peaceful 4-day autumn journey through Kyoto's historic shrines, bamboo groves, and Nishiki Market. Focused on slow mornings and cultural depth.

lodging_anchor.name: Boutique Gion Ryokan
lodging_anchor.reason: Authentic historic base with walking access to temples.

activities.title: Check-in at Boutique Gion Ryokan
activities.description: Settle in and drop bags at this historic ryokan.

activities.title: Kiyomizu-dera Wooden Terrace
activities.description: Visit the iconic temple in the late afternoon to avoid peak bus crowds.

activities.title: Lantern Walk through Ninenzaka & Sannenzaka
activities.description: Beautiful evening walk when the shops close and the lanterns light up the stone streets.

activities.title: Traditional Kaiseki Dinner in Pontocho Alley
activities.description: An intimate multi-course dinner overlooking the Kamo River.

activities.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove Walk
activities.description: Arrive early before 9 AM to get photos without the massive crowds.

activities.title: Tenryu-ji Zen Garden
activities.description: Explore the UNESCO world heritage landscape garden.

activities.title: Tofu Feast overlooking Togetsukyo Bridge
activities.description: Traditional Kyoto tofu lunch with river views.

title: Spiritual Weekend in the Himalayas
summary: A revitalizing 3-day spiritual retreat by the Ganges. Combining morning yoga, ancient Beatles Ashram ruins, and evening Aarti ceremonies.

lodging_anchor.name: Aloha on the Ganges
lodging_anchor.reason: Serene riverfront views with easy access to cafes and Laxman Jhula.

activities.title: Check-in at Aloha on the Ganges
activities.description: Unwind and take in the Himalayan breeze.

activities.title: Lunch at Little Buddha Cafe
activities.description: Popular treehouse-style cafe with great vegan options and river views.

activities.title: Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat
activities.description: Arrive early to get a seat on the steps. A deeply moving spiritual fire ceremony.

activities.title: Explore Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia)
activities.description: Walk through the historic ruins where the Beatles meditated in 1968.

activities.title: Vashishta Gufa Meditation Cave
activities.description: A very quiet, ancient cave an hour out of town. Highly spiritual and serene.

activities.title: Ayurvedic Dinner
activities.description: Healthy, sattvic food to end a spiritual day.

title: Lisbon Culinary & Heritage Explorer
summary: A 5-day deep dive into Lisbon's culinary scene, Fado music, and maritime history, avoiding the steep tourist traps.

lodging_anchor.name: Boutique Chiado Hotel
lodging_anchor.reason: Flat walking access to the metro and central to all major dining districts.

activities.title: Check-in at Chiado
activities.description: Drop bags and freshen up.

activities.title: São Jorge Castle Views
activities.description: Take Tram 28 up, but walk down. Great golden hour views.

activities.title: Fado Dinner at Clube de Fado
activities.description: Traditional Portuguese dinner accompanied by live melancholic Fado singing.

activities.title: Jerónimos Monastery
activities.description: Buy tickets online beforehand to skip the massive 1-hour queue.

activities.title: Pastéis de Belém
activities.description: The original egg tart bakery. The line moves fast, don't be intimidated.

activities.title: Belém Tower & Riverfront
activities.description: Iconic defensive tower on the river tagus.

title: Delhi Heritage & Street Food Dash
summary: An action-packed 2 days focusing on Mughal architecture and the sensory overload of Old Delhi's food markets.

lodging_anchor.name: Connaught Place Heritage Stay
lodging_anchor.reason: Central hub for the Metro Yellow Line, making travel to Old and South Delhi easy.

activities.title: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
activities.description: Go early before the heat and tour bus crowds.

activities.title: Jama Masjid
activities.description: Climb the minaret for an incredible view of the old city.

activities.title: Karim's Lunch in Old Delhi
activities.description: Legendary Mughlai food hidden in an alleyway near Jama Masjid.

activities.title: Rickshaw through Chandni Chowk & Khari Baoli
activities.description: Asia's largest spice market. Prepare for sensory overload and sneezing!

activities.title: Humayun's Tomb
activities.description: The precursor to the Taj Mahal. Stunning red sandstone architecture.

activities.title: Lunch at Khan Market
activities.description: Upscale dining and boutique shopping.

activities.title: Sunset at Lodhi Gardens
activities.description: A beautiful park scattered with 15th-century tombs where locals jog and relax.
